panels.title: Return within a week
panels.description: Of the people who sent a message 8 to 30 days ago, how many sent another within the 7 days after, not counting a return in the two days after a message the coach wrote first. The ledger's query G1, as written there.

targets.rawSql:
with days as (
  select distinct d.user_id, s.created_at::date as day
  from statements s
  join discussions d on d.id = s.discussion_id
  join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id
  join users u on u.id = d.user_id
  where sp.type = 'Subject' and u.username not like 'claude-test%'
    and not exists (select 1 from diagrams dg where dg.id = d.diagram_id and dg.scratch)
    and s.created_at > now() - interval '37 days'
)
select count(distinct a.user_id) as chatted_8_to_30_days_ago,
       count(distinct a.user_id) filter (where exists (
         select 1 from days b where b.user_id = a.user_id and b.day > a.day and b.day <= a.day + 7
           and not exists (select 1 from proactive_messages pm where pm.user_id = a.user_id
                           and pm.sent_at between b.day - interval '2 days' and b.day + interval '1 day')
       )) as came_back_within_7_days
from days a
where a.day > current_date - 30 and a.day <= current_date - 7;

panels.title: From invitation to second sitting
panels.description: People who used an invitation in the time range (the claude-test invitations left out), then how many of them sent a first message, had something written to their record (a person, event, pair-bond or emotion, by the coach or by hand), and came back for a second sitting.

targets.rawSql:
with real_dg as (select dg.id as diagram_id, dg.user_id from diagrams dg join users u on u.id = dg.user_id
            where not dg.scratch and u.username not like 'claude-test%'),
sit as (select d.id as sitting_id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id, min(s.created_at) as started, max(s.created_at) as ended,
               row_number() over w as nth, lead(min(s.created_at)) over w as next_started
        from discussions d join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = d.diagram_id
        join statements s on s.discussion_id = d.id and s.kind::text = 'turn'
        join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id
        where not d.synthetic and d.kind::text = 'chat'
        group by d.id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id having bool_or(sp.type::text = 'Subject')
        window w as (partition by d.user_id order by min(s.created_at))),
delta as (select dc.id as change_id, dc.diagram_id, dc.turn_id, dc.statement_id, dc.author::text as author, dc.created_at,
                 x.o, x.d->>'item_kind' as item_kind, x.d->>'item_id' as item_id, x.d->>'field' as field,
                 x.d->'before' as before, x.d->'after' as after,
                 case when x.d->>'field' is null and jsonb_typeof(x.d->'after') = 'object' then 'add'
                      when x.d->>'field' is null then 'remove' else 'set' end as op
          from diagram_changes dc join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = dc.diagram_id
          cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(dc.deltas) with ordinality as x(d, o)),
inv as (select distinct lower(i.email) as email from invitations i
       where i.used_at is not null and i.email not like 'claude-test%' and $__timeFilter(i.used_at)),
acc as (select inv.email, u.id as user_id from inv join users u on lower(u.username) = inv.email)
select '1. Used the invitation' as step, (select count(*) from inv) as people
union all
select '2. Sent a first message', count(distinct a.user_id) from acc a join sit s on s.user_id = a.user_id
union all
select '3. Something written to the record', count(distinct a.user_id) from acc a
join real_dg r on r.user_id = a.user_id join delta dl on dl.diagram_id = r.diagram_id
where dl.author in ('coach', 'user') and dl.item_kind in ('person', 'event', 'pair_bond', 'emotion')
union all
select '4. Came back for a second sitting', count(distinct a.user_id) from acc a join sit s on s.user_id = a.user_id and s.nth = 2
order by 1

panels.title: Second sitting within 7 days, by what the first sitting did
panels.description: First sittings that ended more than 7 days ago, split by whether the coach wrote to the record in them and by how they ended (a fault, a write, a question, neither); how many were followed by a second sitting within 7 days of the first one's end.

targets.rawSql:
with real_dg as (select dg.id as diagram_id, dg.user_id from diagrams dg join users u on u.id = dg.user_id
            where not dg.scratch and u.username not like 'claude-test%'),
sit as (select d.id as sitting_id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id, min(s.created_at) as started, max(s.created_at) as ended,
               row_number() over w as nth, lead(min(s.created_at)) over w as next_started
        from discussions d join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = d.diagram_id
        join statements s on s.discussion_id = d.id and s.kind::text = 'turn'
        join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id
        where not d.synthetic and d.kind::text = 'chat'
        group by d.id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id having bool_or(sp.type::text = 'Subject')
        window w as (partition by d.user_id order by min(s.created_at))),
msg as (select s.id as statement_id, s.discussion_id as sitting_id, s.turn_id, s.created_at, s.text, s.prompt_version,
               case sp.type::text when 'Subject' then 'person' else 'coach' end as who,
               row_number() over (partition by s.discussion_id order by s."order", s.id) as pos
        from statements s join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id join sit on sit.sitting_id = s.discussion_id
        where s.kind::text = 'turn'),
turn as (select m.turn_id, m.sitting_id, m.statement_id as reply_id, m.created_at as at, m.text,
                coalesce(m.prompt_version, 'none') as prompt_version,
                row_number() over (partition by m.sitting_id order by m.pos) as idx
         from msg m where m.who = 'coach' and m.turn_id is not null),
delta as (select dc.id as change_id, dc.diagram_id, dc.turn_id, dc.statement_id, dc.author::text as author, dc.created_at,
                 x.o, x.d->>'item_kind' as item_kind, x.d->>'item_id' as item_id, x.d->>'field' as field,
                 x.d->'before' as before, x.d->'after' as after,
                 case when x.d->>'field' is null and jsonb_typeof(x.d->'after') = 'object' then 'add'
                      when x.d->>'field' is null then 'remove' else 'set' end as op
          from diagram_changes dc join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = dc.diagram_id
          cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(dc.deltas) with ordinality as x(d, o)),
wrote as (select te.turn_id from turn_events te where te.kind='tool_call' and te.payload->>'refusal' is null
            and te.payload->>'name' in ('edit_person','edit_pair_bond','edit_event','edit_cluster','merge_people','remove','undo')
          union select dl.turn_id from delta dl where dl.author='coach' and dl.item_kind in ('person','event','pair_bond','emotion')),
ct as (select distinct on (turn_id) turn_id, sitting_id, at, prompt_version, idx from turn order by turn_id, idx),
lt as (select distinct on (m.sitting_id) m.sitting_id, m.turn_id from msg m where m.turn_id is not null
       order by m.sitting_id, m.pos desc),
ending as (select lt.sitting_id, lt.turn_id,
                  case when exists (select 1 from observations o where o.turn_id = lt.turn_id
                                    and o.kind::text in ('turn_failed', 'turn_declined', 'step_cap', 'tool_refused'))
                         then 'fault: the turn failed, was declined, hit its step limit or had a tool refused'
                       when exists (select 1 from wrote w where w.turn_id = lt.turn_id) then 'wrote to the record'
                       when rtrim(coalesce(lr.text, '')) like '%?'
                         or exists (select 1 from turn_events te where te.turn_id = lt.turn_id and te.kind = 'tool_call'
                                    and te.payload->>'refusal' is null and te.payload->>'name' in ('add_question', 'set_question')
                                    and te.payload->'args'->>'state' = 'asked')
                         then 'asked a question'
                       else 'neither: no write, no question' end as ending
           from lt left join lateral (select m.text from msg m where m.sitting_id = lt.sitting_id and m.turn_id = lt.turn_id
                                      and m.who = 'coach' order by m.pos desc limit 1) lr on true),
fs as (select s.*, e.ending, exists (select 1 from ct t join wrote w on w.turn_id = t.turn_id where t.sitting_id = s.sitting_id) as wrote
       from sit s join ending e on e.sitting_id = s.sitting_id
       where s.nth = 1 and s.ended < now() - interval '7 days' and $__timeFilter(s.started))
select case when wrote then 'the coach wrote to the record' else 'nothing written' end as "first sitting",
       ending as "how it ended", count(*) as "first sittings",
       count(*) filter (where next_started <= ended + interval '7 days') as "second within 7 days",
       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where next_started <= ended + interval '7 days') / count(*), 1) as "share (%)"
from fs group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

panels.title: How sittings end
panels.description: Each sitting by its last turn: a fault (failed, declined, step limit, refused tool), a write to the record, a question from the coach (the reply ends in a question mark or keeps a question as asked), or neither. Beside it: who had the last word, the median days until that person's next sitting, and sittings with no next one yet.

targets.rawSql:
with real_dg as (select dg.id as diagram_id, dg.user_id from diagrams dg join users u on u.id = dg.user_id
            where not dg.scratch and u.username not like 'claude-test%'),
sit as (select d.id as sitting_id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id, min(s.created_at) as started, max(s.created_at) as ended,
               row_number() over w as nth, lead(min(s.created_at)) over w as next_started
        from discussions d join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = d.diagram_id
        join statements s on s.discussion_id = d.id and s.kind::text = 'turn'

        group by d.id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id having bool_or(sp.type::text = 'Subject')
        window w as (partition by d.user_id order by min(s.created_at))),
msg as (select s.id as statement_id, s.discussion_id as sitting_id, s.turn_id, s.created_at, s.text, s.prompt_version,
               case sp.type::text when 'Subject' then 'person' else 'coach' end as who,
               row_number() over (partition by s.discussion_id order by s."order", s.id) as pos
        from statements s join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id join sit on sit.sitting_id = s.discussion_id
        where s.kind::text = 'turn'),
delta as (select dc.id as change_id, dc.diagram_id, dc.turn_id, dc.statement_id, dc.author::text as author, dc.created_at,
                 x.o, x.d->>'item_kind' as item_kind, x.d->>'item_id' as item_id, x.d->>'field' as field,
                 x.d->'before' as before, x.d->'after' as after,
                 case when x.d->>'field' is null and jsonb_typeof(x.d->'after') = 'object' then 'add'
                      when x.d->>'field' is null then 'remove' else 'set' end as op
          from diagram_changes dc join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = dc.diagram_id
          cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(dc.deltas) with ordinality as x(d, o)),
fieldval as (select dl.diagram_id, dl.item_kind, dl.item_id, dl.change_id, dl.o, kv.key as field, kv.value as val
             from delta dl cross join lateral jsonb_each(case when dl.op = 'add' then dl.after
                                                    else jsonb_build_object(dl.field, dl.after) end) kv
             where dl.op in ('add','set')),
cur as (select distinct on (diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, field) diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, field, val
        from fieldval order by diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, field, change_id desc, o desc),
removed as (select diagram_id, item_kind, item_id from (
              select distinct on (diagram_id, item_kind, item_id) diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, op from delta
              where op in ('add','remove') order by diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, change_id desc, o desc) x
            where op = 'remove'),
person as (select diagram_id, item_id as person_id,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='name') as name,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='last_name') as last_name,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='parents') as parents,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='gender') as gender
           from cur c where item_kind = 'person'
             and not exists (select 1 from removed x where (x.diagram_id,x.item_kind,x.item_id)=(c.diagram_id,c.item_kind,c.item_id))
           group by 1,2),
wrote as (select te.turn_id from turn_events te where te.kind='tool_call' and te.payload->>'refusal' is null
            and te.payload->>'name' in ('edit_person','edit_pair_bond','edit_event','edit_cluster','merge_people','remove','undo')
          union select dl.turn_id from delta dl where dl.author='coach' and dl.item_kind in ('person','event','pair_bond','emotion')),
lt as (select distinct on (m.sitting_id) m.sitting_id, m.turn_id from msg m where m.turn_id is not null
       order by m.sitting_id, m.pos desc),
ending as (select lt.sitting_id, lt.turn_id,
                  case when exists (select 1 from observations o where o.turn_id = lt.turn_id
                                    and o.kind::text in ('turn_failed', 'turn_declined', 'step_cap', 'tool_refused'))
                         then 'fault: the turn failed, was declined, hit its step limit or had a tool refused'
                       when exists (select 1 from wrote w where w.turn_id = lt.turn_id) then 'wrote to the record'
                       when rtrim(coalesce(lr.text, '')) like '%?'
                         or exists (select 1 from turn_events te where te.turn_id = lt.turn_id and te.kind = 'tool_call'
                                    and te.payload->>'refusal' is null and te.payload->>'name' in ('add_question', 'set_question')
                                    and te.payload->'args'->>'state' = 'asked')
                         then 'asked a question'
                       else 'neither: no write, no question' end as ending
           from lt left join lateral (select m.text from msg m where m.sitting_id = lt.sitting_id and m.turn_id = lt.turn_id
                                      and m.who = 'coach' order by m.pos desc limit 1) lr on true),
lw as (select distinct on (sitting_id) sitting_id, who from msg order by sitting_id, pos desc)
select e.ending as "how it ended", count(*) as sittings, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) over (), 1) as "share (%)",
       count(*) filter (where lw.who = 'person') as "the person had the last word",
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by extract(epoch from s.next_started - s.ended)::float8 / 86400))::numeric, 1) as "median days to the next sitting",
       count(*) filter (where s.next_started is null) as "no next sitting yet"
from sit s join ending e on e.sitting_id = s.sitting_id join lw on lw.sitting_id = s.sitting_id
where $__timeFilter(s.started)
group by 1 order by 2 desc, 1

panels.title: The last thing before silence
panels.description: People still signed up who have sent nothing for 28 days: what the coach's last turn to them did (asked for a fact, its main topic, the chips in the reply, two events or years side by side, voiced a guess, a fault), as a share of those last turns, beside the share among all coach turns in the time range. The ratio shows once 30 people are silent.

targets.rawSql:
with real_dg as (select dg.id as diagram_id, dg.user_id from diagrams dg join users u on u.id = dg.user_id
            where not dg.scratch and u.username not like 'claude-test%'),
sit as (select d.id as sitting_id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id, min(s.created_at) as started, max(s.created_at) as ended,
               row_number() over w as nth, lead(min(s.created_at)) over w as next_started
        from discussions d join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = d.diagram_id
        join statements s on s.discussion_id = d.id and s.kind::text = 'turn'
        join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id
        where not d.synthetic and d.kind::text = 'chat'
        group by d.id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id having bool_or(sp.type::text = 'Subject')
        window w as (partition by d.user_id order by min(s.created_at))),
msg as (select s.id as statement_id, s.discussion_id as sitting_id, s.turn_id, s.created_at, s.text, s.prompt_version,
               case sp.type::text when 'Subject' then 'person' else 'coach' end as who,
               row_number() over (partition by s.discussion_id order by s."order", s.id) as pos
        from statements s join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id join sit on sit.sitting_id = s.discussion_id
        where s.kind::text = 'turn'),
turn as (select m.turn_id, m.sitting_id, m.statement_id as reply_id, m.created_at as at, m.text,
                coalesce(m.prompt_version, 'none') as prompt_version,
                row_number() over (partition by m.sitting_id order by m.pos) as idx
         from msg m where m.who = 'coach' and m.turn_id is not null),
delta as (select dc.id as change_id, dc.diagram_id, dc.turn_id, dc.statement_id, dc.author::text as author, dc.created_at,
                 x.o, x.d->>'item_kind' as item_kind, x.d->>'item_id' as item_id, x.d->>'field' as field,
                 x.d->'before' as before, x.d->'after' as after,
                 case when x.d->>'field' is null and jsonb_typeof(x.d->'after') = 'object' then 'add'
                      when x.d->>'field' is null then 'remove' else 'set' end as op
          from diagram_changes dc join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = dc.diagram_id
          cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(dc.deltas) with ordinality as x(d, o)),
fieldval as (select dl.diagram_id, dl.item_kind, dl.item_id, dl.change_id, dl.o, kv.key as field, kv.value as val
             from delta dl cross join lateral jsonb_each(case when dl.op = 'add' then dl.after
                                                    else jsonb_build_object(dl.field, dl.after) end) kv
             where dl.op in ('add','set')),
cur as (select distinct on (diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, field) diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, field, val
        from fieldval order by diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, field, change_id desc, o desc),
removed as (select diagram_id, item_kind, item_id from (
              select distinct on (diagram_id, item_kind, item_id) diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, op from delta
              where op in ('add','remove') order by diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, change_id desc, o desc) x
            where op = 'remove'),
person as (select diagram_id, item_id as person_id,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='name') as name,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='last_name') as last_name,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='parents') as parents,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='gender') as gender
           from cur c where item_kind = 'person'
             and not exists (select 1 from removed x where (x.diagram_id,x.item_kind,x.item_id)=(c.diagram_id,c.item_kind,c.item_id))
           group by 1,2),
event_state as (select diagram_id, item_id as event_id,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='kind') as kind, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='item') as item,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='symptom') as symptom, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='anxiety') as anxiety,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='functioning') as functioning, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='relationship') as relationship,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='person') as person, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='spouse') as spouse,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='child') as child, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='dateTime') as date_time
                from cur where item_kind='event' group by 1,2),
ct as (select distinct on (turn_id) turn_id, sitting_id, at, prompt_version, idx from turn order by turn_id, idx),
quest as (select c.diagram_id, c.item_id as qid,
                  max(c.val#>>'{}') filter (where c.field = 'kind') as kind,
                  max(c.val#>>'{}') filter (where c.field = 'fact') as fact,
                  max(c.val#>>'{}') filter (where c.field = 'item_kind') as on_kind,
                  max(c.val#>>'{}') filter (where c.field = 'item_id') as on_id,
                  max(c.val#>>'{}') filter (where c.field = 'state') as state,
                  max(c.val#>>'{}') filter (where c.field = 'outcome') as outcome,
                  max(c.val#>>'{}') filter (where c.field = 'pushback') as pushback
           from cur c where c.item_kind = 'question'
             and not exists (select 1 from removed x where (x.diagram_id, x.item_kind, x.item_id) = (c.diagram_id, c.item_kind, c.item_id))
           group by 1, 2),
qa as (select te.turn_id, te.payload->'args'->>'fact' as fact, te.payload->'args'->>'item_kind' as on_kind,
                 te.payload->'args'->>'item_id' as on_id, te.payload->'args'->>'state' as state
          from turn_events te
          where te.kind = 'tool_call' and te.payload->>'refusal' is null and te.payload->>'name' = 'add_question'
            and te.payload->'args'->>'kind' = 'fact' and te.payload->'args'->>'state' in ('asked', 'held')
          union all
          select te.turn_id, q.fact, q.on_kind, q.on_id, 'asked'
          from turn_events te join ct t on t.turn_id = te.turn_id join sit s on s.sitting_id = t.sitting_id
          join quest q on q.diagram_id = s.diagram_id and q.qid = te.payload->'args'->>'id'
          where te.kind = 'tool_call' and te.payload->>'refusal' is null and te.payload->>'name' = 'set_question'
            and te.payload->'args'->>'state' = 'asked' and q.kind = 'fact'),
asked as (select qa.*, t.at, t.prompt_version, t.sitting_id from qa join ct t on t.turn_id = qa.turn_id),
fault as (select o.turn_id, o.kind::text as kind from observations o
          where o.kind::text in ('tool_refused', 'step_cap', 'turn_failed', 'turn_declined', 'duplicate_person', 'duplicate_event',
                                 'play_refused', 'play_failed', 'cluster_refused', 'cluster_failed')
          union
          select mc.turn_id, 'model_fallback' from model_calls mc where mc.purpose::text = 'coach' and mc.fallback is not null),
ft as (select f.turn_id, f.kind, m.sitting_id, max(m.pos) as last_pos, max(m.created_at) as at,
              coalesce(max(tt.prompt_version), 'none') as prompt_version
       from fault f join msg m on m.turn_id = f.turn_id left join turn tt on tt.turn_id = f.turn_id
       group by 1, 2, 3),
hook as (
  select dl.turn_id, 'person:' || case when dl.op = 'set' then dl.field else dl.op end as hook
  from delta dl where dl.author = 'coach' and dl.item_kind = 'person'
  union all
  select dl.turn_id, dl.item_kind from delta dl where dl.author = 'coach' and dl.item_kind in ('pair_bond', 'emotion')
  union all
  select dl.turn_id, h.hook from delta dl
  join event_state e on e.diagram_id = dl.diagram_id and e.event_id = dl.item_id
  cross join lateral (values ('kind:' || e.kind), ('item:' || e.item),
                             (case when e.symptom is not null then 'shift:symptom' end),
                             (case when e.anxiety is not null then 'shift:anxiety' end),
                             (case when e.functioning is not null then 'shift:functioning' end),
                             ('relationship:' || e.relationship)) h(hook)
  where dl.author = 'coach' and dl.item_kind = 'event' and h.hook is not null and not (dl.op = 'set' and dl.field = 'dateTime')
  union all
  select dl.turn_id, 'fact:' || q.fact from delta dl join quest q on q.diagram_id = dl.diagram_id and q.qid = dl.item_id
  where dl.author = 'coach' and dl.item_kind = 'question' and q.kind = 'fact'),
topic_map(hook, topic) as (values ('kind:bonded', 'Partners'), ('kind:married', 'Partners'), ('kind:separated', 'Partners'), ('kind:divorced', 'Partners'), ('pair_bond', 'Partners'), ('fact:met', 'Partners'), ('fact:marriages', 'Partners'), ('kind:birth', 'Children and births'), ('kind:adopted', 'Children and births'), ('fact:birth_date', 'Children and births'), ('fact:children', 'Children and births'), ('fact:order', 'Children and births'), ('fact:sex', 'Children and births'), ('person:parents', 'Children and births'), ('person:gender', 'Children and births'), ('kind:death', 'Deaths'), ('fact:alive', 'Deaths'), ('fact:death_date', 'Deaths'), ('fact:cause_of_death', 'Deaths'), ('item:health', 'Health and symptoms'), ('shift:symptom', 'Health and symptoms'), ('fact:health', 'Health and symptoms'), ('item:work', 'Work and livelihood'), ('fact:work', 'Work and livelihood'), ('fact:life_course', 'Work and livelihood'), ('item:schooling', 'School'), ('fact:schooling', 'School'), ('item:places', 'Moves and places'), ('fact:places', 'Moves and places'), ('relationship:fusion', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:conflict', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:distance', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:overfunctioning', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:underfunctioning', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:projection', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:defined-self', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:toward', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:away', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:inside', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:outside', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:cutoff', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('emotion', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('fact:contact', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('shift:anxiety', 'How people were doing'), ('shift:functioning', 'How people were doing'), ('fact:stress', 'Hard times'), ('fact:most_going_on', 'Hard times'), ('person:add', 'Who is who'), ('person:remove', 'Who is who'), ('person:name', 'Who is who'), ('person:parents', 'Who is who'), ('fact:name', 'Who is who'), ('fact:parents', 'Who is who')),
main_topic as (select distinct on (turn_id) turn_id, topic from (
                 select h.turn_id, coalesce(tm.topic, 'no topic') as topic, count(*) as n
                 from hook h left join topic_map tm on tm.hook = h.hook group by 1, 2) x
               order by turn_id, topic = 'no topic', n desc, topic),
said_last as (select s.user_id, max(m.created_at) as last_at from msg m join sit s on s.sitting_id = m.sitting_id
              where m.who = 'person' group by 1),
silent as (select l.user_id from said_last l join users u on u.id = l.user_id where u.active and l.last_at < now() - interval '28 days'),
last_turn as (select distinct on (s.user_id) s.user_id, t.turn_id from ct t join sit s on s.sitting_id = t.sitting_id
              join silent on silent.user_id = s.user_id order by s.user_id, t.at desc),
rt as (select turn_id, string_agg(text, ' ' order by idx) as text from turn group by 1),
feat as (select a.turn_id, 'asked about: ' || coalesce(a.fact, 'a fact') as feature from asked a where a.state = 'asked'
         union select mt.turn_id, 'main topic: ' || mt.topic from main_topic mt
         union select rt.turn_id, 'chip: ' || c[1] from rt cross join lateral regexp_matches(rt.text, '\[\[([a-z_]+):', 'g') c
         union select rt.turn_id, 'two events or years side by side' from rt
               where (select count(*) from regexp_matches(rt.text, '\[\[event:', 'g')) >= 2
                  or (select count(distinct y[1]) from regexp_matches(rt.text, '\m((?:1[89]|20)\d\d)\M', 'g') y) >= 2
         union select g.turn_id, 'voiced a guess' from turn_events g where g.kind = 'tool_call' and g.payload->>'refusal' is null
               and g.payload->>'name' = 'add_impression'
         union select f.turn_id, 'fault: ' || f.kind from fault f),
base as (select t.turn_id from ct t where $__timeFilter(t.at))
select f.feature, count(*) filter (where f.turn_id in (select turn_id from last_turn)) as "silent people's last turns",
       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where f.turn_id in (select turn_id from last_turn)) / nullif((select count(*) from last_turn), 0), 1) as "share among silent (%)",
       round(100.0 * count(*) filter (where f.turn_id in (select turn_id from base)) / nullif((select count(*) from base), 0), 1) as "share among all coach turns (%)",
       case when (select count(*) from silent) >= 30 then round(
         (count(*) filter (where f.turn_id in (select turn_id from last_turn))::numeric / nullif((select count(*) from last_turn), 0))
         / nullif(count(*) filter (where f.turn_id in (select turn_id from base))::numeric / nullif((select count(*) from base), 0), 0), 2) end as "silent over all"
from feat f
where f.turn_id in (select turn_id from last_turn) or f.turn_id in (select turn_id from base)
group by 1 order by 2 desc, 4 desc, 1

panels.title: Active, silent, left
panels.description: Everyone with a sitting: left (no longer signed up), active (sent a message in the last 28 days), or silent (still signed up, nothing for 28 days).

targets.rawSql:
with real_dg as (select dg.id as diagram_id, dg.user_id from diagrams dg join users u on u.id = dg.user_id
            where not dg.scratch and u.username not like 'claude-test%'),
sit as (select d.id as sitting_id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id, min(s.created_at) as started, max(s.created_at) as ended,
               row_number() over w as nth, lead(min(s.created_at)) over w as next_started
        from discussions d join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = d.diagram_id
        join statements s on s.discussion_id = d.id and s.kind::text = 'turn'
        join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id
        where not d.synthetic and d.kind::text = 'chat'
        group by d.id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id having bool_or(sp.type::text = 'Subject')
        window w as (partition by d.user_id order by min(s.created_at))),
msg as (select s.id as statement_id, s.discussion_id as sitting_id, s.turn_id, s.created_at, s.text, s.prompt_version,
               case sp.type::text when 'Subject' then 'person' else 'coach' end as who,
               row_number() over (partition by s.discussion_id order by s."order", s.id) as pos
        from statements s join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id join sit on sit.sitting_id = s.discussion_id
        where s.kind::text = 'turn'),
said_last as (select s.user_id, max(m.created_at) as last_at from msg m join sit s on s.sitting_id = m.sitting_id
              where m.who = 'person' group by 1)
select v.state, count(x.user_id) as people
from (values ('active', 1), ('silent', 2), ('left', 3)) v(state, o)
left join (select l.user_id, case when not u.active then 'left' when l.last_at >= now() - interval '28 days' then 'active'
                                  else 'silent' end as state
           from said_last l join users u on u.id = l.user_id) x on x.state = v.state
group by v.state, v.o order by v.o

panels.title: People active each week: first week and returning
panels.description: People who sent a message that week: those in their first week, and those who started before.

targets.rawSql:
with real_dg as (select dg.id as diagram_id, dg.user_id from diagrams dg join users u on u.id = dg.user_id
            where not dg.scratch and u.username not like 'claude-test%'),
sit as (select d.id as sitting_id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id, min(s.created_at) as started, max(s.created_at) as ended,
               row_number() over w as nth, lead(min(s.created_at)) over w as next_started
        from discussions d join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = d.diagram_id
        join statements s on s.discussion_id = d.id and s.kind::text = 'turn'
        join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id
        where not d.synthetic and d.kind::text = 'chat'
        group by d.id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id having bool_or(sp.type::text = 'Subject')
        window w as (partition by d.user_id order by min(s.created_at))),
msg as (select s.id as statement_id, s.discussion_id as sitting_id, s.turn_id, s.created_at, s.text, s.prompt_version,
               case sp.type::text when 'Subject' then 'person' else 'coach' end as who,
               row_number() over (partition by s.discussion_id order by s."order", s.id) as pos
        from statements s join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id join sit on sit.sitting_id = s.discussion_id
        where s.kind::text = 'turn'),
pwk as (select distinct s.user_id, date_trunc('week', m.created_at) as wk from msg m
        join sit s on s.sitting_id = m.sitting_id where m.who = 'person'),
first_wk as (select user_id, min(wk) as wk from pwk group by 1)
select p.wk as time, case when p.wk = f.wk then 'first week' else 'returning' end as metric, count(*) as value
from pwk p join first_wk f on f.user_id = p.user_id
where $__timeFilter(p.wk)
group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

panels.title: Days between sittings
panels.description: Days from the end of a sitting to the start of the same person's next one, for sittings that started in the time range.

targets.rawSql:
with real_dg as (select dg.id as diagram_id, dg.user_id from diagrams dg join users u on u.id = dg.user_id
            where not dg.scratch and u.username not like 'claude-test%'),
sit as (select d.id as sitting_id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id, min(s.created_at) as started, max(s.created_at) as ended,
               row_number() over w as nth, lead(min(s.created_at)) over w as next_started
        from discussions d join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = d.diagram_id
        join statements s on s.discussion_id = d.id and s.kind::text = 'turn'
        join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id
        where not d.synthetic and d.kind::text = 'chat'
        group by d.id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id having bool_or(sp.type::text = 'Subject')
        window w as (partition by d.user_id order by min(s.created_at))),
gap as (select s.user_id, s.started, (extract(epoch from s.next_started - s.ended) / 86400)::float8 as days
       from sit s where s.next_started is not null)
select b.label as "days between sittings", count(g.days) as gaps,
       round(100.0 * count(g.days) / nullif(sum(count(g.days)) over (), 0), 1) as "share (%)"
from (values ('0-1', 0, 1, 1), ('1-3', 1, 3, 2), ('3-7', 3, 7, 3), ('7-14', 7, 14, 4), ('14-28', 14, 28, 5), ('more than 28', 28, 1000000, 6)) b(label, lo, hi, o)
left join gap g on g.days >= b.lo and g.days < b.hi and $__timeFilter(g.started)
group by b.label, b.o order by b.o

panels.title: Days between sittings by cohort month
panels.description: The same gaps, by the month of each person's first sitting: people, gaps in each band, and the median gap.

targets.rawSql:
with real_dg as (select dg.id as diagram_id, dg.user_id from diagrams dg join users u on u.id = dg.user_id
            where not dg.scratch and u.username not like 'claude-test%'),
sit as (select d.id as sitting_id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id, min(s.created_at) as started, max(s.created_at) as ended,
               row_number() over w as nth, lead(min(s.created_at)) over w as next_started
        from discussions d join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = d.diagram_id
        join statements s on s.discussion_id = d.id and s.kind::text = 'turn'
        join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id
        where not d.synthetic and d.kind::text = 'chat'
        group by d.id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id having bool_or(sp.type::text = 'Subject')
        window w as (partition by d.user_id order by min(s.created_at))),
gap as (select s.user_id, s.started, (extract(epoch from s.next_started - s.ended) / 86400)::float8 as days
       from sit s where s.next_started is not null),
cohort as (select user_id, min(started) as first_at from sit group by 1)
select to_char(date_trunc('month', c.first_at), 'YYYY-MM') as "first sitting in", count(distinct c.user_id) as people,
       count(g.days) as gaps,
       count(*) filter (where g.days < 1) as "0-1", count(*) filter (where g.days >= 1 and g.days < 3) as "1-3",
       count(*) filter (where g.days >= 3 and g.days < 7) as "3-7", count(*) filter (where g.days >= 7 and g.days < 14) as "7-14",
       count(*) filter (where g.days >= 14 and g.days < 28) as "14-28", count(*) filter (where g.days >= 28) as "more than 28",
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by g.days))::numeric, 1) as "median days"
from cohort c left join gap g on g.user_id = c.user_id
where $__timeFilter(c.first_at)
group by 1 order by 1
